lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>上帝<WH0430>便打發<WH07971><WTH8762>他出伊甸<WH05731>園<WAH04480><WH01588>，去耕種<WAH09001><WH05647><WTH8800>{<WAH0853>}土地<WH0127>；原來自己倒是從<WAH04480>土地<WAH08033>被取出來的<WAH0834>。
lcc_original: 永恆主上帝便打發他出伊甸園，去耕種土地；原來自己倒是從土地被取出來的。
notes: 永恆主 (LCC) = 耶和華 (UNV) = Yahweh <WH03068>; 上帝 (LCC) = 神 (UNV) = Elohim <WH0430> — standard LCC divine-name conventions

UNV relative clause 他所<WAH0834>自出<WH03947><WTH8795>之土 is restructured in LCC as an independent clause 原來自己倒是從土地被取出來的; WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר) attached to sentence-final 的, which functions as the nominalizer/relativizer in this cleft construction (倒是…的)

UNV implicit {<WAH04480>}{<WAH08033>} (מִשָּׁם, 'from there') is made explicit in LCC as 從土地; per rule 3, braces dropped — WAH04480 attaches to 從, WAH08033 attaches to second 土地 (LCC spells out the referent rather than using a demonstrative)
土地 appears twice: first occurrence carries WH0127 (הָאֲדָמָה, the ground — direct object of 耕種); second occurrence carries WAH08033 (שָׁם, 'there' — LCC makes the pronominal referent explicit)
